scope: CI-only two-child startup comparison; original production Node lock-worker spawn mode and its libuv Job ownership are unchanged.
comparison: The exact installed helper image is hashed and held open. Both --state-lease-worker children use the same private desktop, bounded environment, three owned pipes, creation-time Job and verified restricted primary identity/privileges/SIDs.

Each actual suspended child receives only the previously verified current-user TOKEN_QUERY ACE, with original ACE/readback/restriction checks. Probe ACL evidence is separate from the unchanged two original owner/probe records.

CREATE_NO_WINDOW versus DETACHED_PROCESS is the only console-mode variable. Immediate stdin EOF intentionally prevents a lock request or state access. Each child has a five-second observation bound and independently verified Job retirement.

Only a fixed leading lease-entry marker, finite phase/exit/status and cleanup facts are retained; no native paths, raw output or private state. The unchanged original Node/eight-check owner journey still executes afterward and remains the acceptance requirement.

research.finding: Pinned libuv selects CREATE_NO_WINDOW for hidden piped children. Its detached option also skips libuv child-Job assignment, so a direct production detached-flag change was withdrawn before commit. The CI comparison preserves an explicit creation-time Job for both modes.

unpublishedCandidate.reason: Linux checks cannot verify the Windows launch mode or compensate for removed libuv Job assignment.

limits: Native comparison pending. No cause, repair or complete-owner acceptance is inferred from compilation or projection tests.
The fixed EOF probes do not acquire a lease, create state, load a provider, change an account or launch a guest. Their success cannot replace the original failing owner journey.
No broader token rights, privilege/SID/default-DACL/account/runtime fallback or deadline extension is used.
